Class ActionResult

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am23.model.ActionResult
public final class ActionResult extends Object
Immutable response returned by the GameModel for every player action. Carries the originating ActionType, a success flag, an ErrorCode (always ErrorCode.NONE on success) and a human readable message.
